purpose: CPU-only descriptive diagnosis of shared PLS/GPU errors and the matched CNN input
scope: 695 development people, 1064 front124 windows; stored inputs and held-person predictions only

definitions.missing: confidence equals zero; confidence is not a calibrated probability of error
definitions.boundary: any abs(xy)>=1-1e-6; a numeric normalization boundary, not evidence of camera clipping
definitions.observed_boundary_fraction: boundary points with confidence>0 divided by observed points
definitions.missing_boundary_fraction_all_points: boundary points with confidence==0 divided by all points
definitions.leg_step_p95: 95th percentile of normalized-coordinate Euclidean steps across adjacent frames and six observed leg joints; not physical speed
definitions.leg_acceleration_p95: 95th percentile of norm of second frame difference for the six leg joints; not physical acceleration or proven noise
definitions.leg_length_cv_mean: mean of temporal SD/mean lengths for four hip-knee/knee-ankle segments in image coordinates; motion and projection also affect it

person_aggregation: average per-record input features and per-record-side absolute errors within person; each person equal
common_error: minimum of person PLS MAE and person GPU-last-stage MAE; large means both are large
target_distance: mean absolute distance of record-side GDI from the corresponding outer training people mean for that side; diagnostic use of labels only, not an input predictor
associations: Spearman for each feature and each model MAE/common_error; additionally Pearson of global rank residuals centered within person-mean GDI ten-point bin x cohort strata with at least five people. Descriptive adjustment only, not causal identification.
review_group: top ceil(10% * 695)=70 people by common_error; stable person_id order resolves ties; review only, not exclusion or clinical threshold
limits: Selected lower-body-complete windows; no raw RGB or pre-normalization coordinates; no causal claim, input correction, predictive quality cutoff or independent validation
